notes.title: The Chicago Outfit
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/00d3ba19e8a715ec768394c33b53eae57165db8e.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p]The Chicago Outfit is not just another crime syndicate : it is a parallel power structure, rooted deep within every system of the city. Under Al Capone’s reign, it expanded far beyond the seedy neighborhoods, infiltrating Chicago’s political, economic, and industrial spheres.[/p][p]At the heart of its empire lies the meat trade, over which it holds an ironclad monopoly. This control ensures massive revenues, logistical dominance, and a powerful means of pressure over the entire population. From slaughterhouse to port, from transport to restaurant, nothing moves without its approval.[/p][p]The Outfit operates with ruthless efficiency : intimidation, extortion, money laundering, kidnappings, smuggling, vendettas, and assassinations.[/p][p]Its members are chosen for their absolute loyalty, their usefulness, and their silence. Some serve in the shadows, others terrorize in broad daylight. But all follow one rule only : the will of the Godfather.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/ddca46f699263e9679e1d79d6ba9d7123f840725.png"][/img][/p][p]Now you know the key faces of the mafia… but facing the Outfit means stepping into a city that already belongs to them. Its influence reaches farther, higher, and deeper than you could ever imagine. It’s up to you to follow every lead, jam every cog in the machine, and dismantle Al Capone’s sprawling empire before it swallows the entire city of Chicago - or at least, what’s left of it.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/44f5e598b1dafbbf5bcd08f0c6c729750f3acc96.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The hierarchy of the Chicago Outfit is now complete. We’ll soon be posting more content, including various images, backgrounds, and information about the game’s development and features - so stay tuned. See you soon.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – Al Capone
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/e2ba3c3fef2ca3adcf74f1712c93a793245cd5ab.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p][b]Al Capone rules Chicago with an iron hand, calm and firm.[/b][/p][p]His meteoric rise was built on strategy, manipulation, and an ability to break any opponent without getting his hands dirty — or almost.[/p][p]As the Godfather of the Outfit, he oversees the city’s entire meat trade — an empire that not only brings him colossal profits, but also gives him leverage over every layer of society. Between institutional corruption, economic blackmail, and territorial control, nearly every legal or illegal activity in Chicago falls between his claws.[/p][p]His power doesn’t come solely from his allies or his network. Capone himself is a feared fighter. He doesn’t need to throw a punch, but when he chooses to act, he leaves no witnesses.[/p][p]He tolerates neither failure nor betrayal. And those who forget… often end up six feet under.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic puma[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Boss[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][p]Little reliable information exists on Capone’s true sensory abilities. He rarely fights in person and always moves surrounded by his henchmens. Nevertheless, his decisions suggest that he possesses an [b]exceptionally sharp awareness of his surroundings and his enemies. His stature and power forbid any approach or contact, no matter the source, without direct consequences : he is unreachable.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/0ad3f2533f3b1f700d2f9ccea0a7363abda2bda0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – Riley McGuts
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/2da98b832996d4863a1d3613be8a45729d558207.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p][b]Riley "Bullgator" McGuts[/b] is one of the most dangerous individuals identified within the mafia's criminal hierarchy.[/p][p]His massive build and rare pale pigmentation make him easily recognizable. Widely feared within the Chicago Outfit, he answers only to the organization's Boss himself.[/p][p]Known for his brutality and complete lack of empathy, he is primarily involved in the organization’s most violent operations: intimidation, executions, and the dismantling of rival factions. His colossal strength, and his resilience in close combat, combined with his reactivity, make him a formidable threat, even to the strongest opponents.[/p][p]Bullgator is one of the few figures in Chicago for whom spilling blood is more than just a strategic move or part of criminal operations : it’s a primal, instinctive need.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic albino alligator[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Right-hand man[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][p]The exact sensory capabilities of Riley McGuts remain unknown to this day, aside from a [b]noticeably heightened reactivity to external stimuli.[/b] No reliable report has been able to assess them under real conditions, as all direct observation attempts have resulted in serious injuries or the disappearance of involved agents. As such, [b]approaching him under any circumstances is strongly discouraged.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/91f840a403aa92103f06b871b73123bc455a8187.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – Tracy Raskova
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/a082bb68726a71f0ba667762f3b7c7e7a339a864.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p][b]Tracy Raskova[/b], a lynx with steady nerves and razor-sharp eyes, never misses her mark.[/p][p]A methodical sniper with ice-cold blood, her exceptional vision turns every alley into a shooting range, every rooftop into a tactical advantage. Her full capacities remain unknown, but her military-grade precision and predator's gaze make her an unmatched threat to anyone who dares cross the mafia.[/p][p]Respected and feared as a lieutenant within the Chicago Outfit, she operates from the shadows : cold and calculating, always out of reach and one step ahead.[/p][p]They say she handles her rifle the way others handle words: with precision and no mercy.
Ending up in her line of sight is as good as having one foot in the grave.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic lynx[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Capo[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][p]Due to the unknown extent of her potential and the classified nature of some of her abilities, her exact threat level is difficult to determine. However, all available data suggests [b]advanced military training[/b], [b]engaging her alone or unprepared is strongly discouraged.[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] 🟢 Highly developped[/p][p]→ Detects any visible presence or threat within [b]extreme range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] ⚫ Unknown[/p][p]→ No available data. [b]Sensory level unverified.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/738da36f759ce91e0f3584781001dd1aaac9a4b9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – The Bear
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/3240eb3181ca17d9788642d8c3867196d1bad719.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p]Mafia enforcer, more massive than his peers, he commands respect by his mere presence. His sharpened hearing captures the slightest suspicious noise, even from a distance, allowing him to react before others. Armed with a shotgun, he prefers the brutal confrontation to subtlety. Be ready before facing him, because a poorly prepared duel will earn you a failure in beauty.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic Bear[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Caid[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] 🔵 Active[/p][p]→ Detects any visible presence or threat within [b]medium range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] 🔴 Inactive[/p][p]→ [b]Cannot detect[/b] presence through scent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] 🟢 Developped[/p][p]→ Can perceive sounds, [b]even those not directly reaching him.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/c088de41087bf7f7b55b5e0a231cbb8ed5ae8f53.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – The Vulture
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/e4915a09da47501ad47d008ae0a0150a711cad81.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p]Unofficial sentinel of the mafia, posted high or in the back, he watches relentlessly: suspicious movements, isolated targets, nothing escapes his sharp sight. Armed with a long-range rifle, he never misses his target. Beware of your surroundings and the heights, because he has probably seen you before you noticed him.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic Vulture[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Spotter[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] 🟢 Developped[/p][p]→ Detects any visible presence or threat within [b]extented range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] 🔴 Inactive[/p][p]→ [b]Cannot detect[/b] presence through scent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] 🔵 Active[/p][p]→ Can perceive sounds only if [b]they reach it directly.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/c41ed0ece10a62b096a084d5501845a944946ce0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – The Wolf
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/f90d10f2ebedd9c0adde35c18472cacdd7332e98.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p]Experienced mafia henchman, he obeys without question, but knows how to smell when things go wrong. With his handgun always within range and an unusual sense of smell, he spots his targets before even seeing them. Avoid underestimating it, because it will not give you a second chance to hide.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic Wolf[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Henchmen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] 🔵 Active[/p][p]→ Detects any visible presence or threat within [b]medium range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] 🟢 Developped[/p][p]→ [b]Can detect[/b] presence by smells, [b]even through obstacles.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] 🔵 Active[/p][p]→ Can perceive sounds only if [b]they reach it directly.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/3c5f4ca816cf1287d0e126566882044be35c17df.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Chicago Outfit – The Hyena
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/68b7a6f062a30994a11a90acf7380a2894c1dcba.png"][/img][/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/6f1150f6d2a3e004b07b42a4ea4c4ef1043c1188.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Description[/b][/h3][p]Basic mafia mobster, he executes orders without initiative : dirty works and ungrateful tasks, the slightest distraction can make him react. Individually not very threatening and mostly using their fists or cold weapons, their presence in a group can easily overwhelm an unprepared team.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Classification[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Species :[/b] Anthropomorphic Hyena[/p][/*][*][p][b]Affiliation :[/b] Mafia[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank :[/b] Thug[/p][/*][*][p][b]Status :[/b] Hostile[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Sensory Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sight:[/b] 🔵 Active[/p][p]→ Detects any visible presence or threat within [b]medium range.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Smell:[/b] 🔴 Inactive[/p][p]→ [b]Cannot detect[/b] presence through scent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hearing:[/b] 🔵 Active[/p][p]→ Can perceive sounds only if [b]they reach it directly.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/29c83164b4e3438f8c9dfc944ff5f19e431c8c99.png"][/img][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/7b5700a9223b033841c347f1f673aedb59ec5d2d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]This is just the beginning : other shadow faces will soon appear. Stay alert in the coming weeks to discover the new figures that make up this mafia organization, the Chicago Outfit.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513853/48823439ab2dede3df2a0e234fbb671c5b8748c7.png"][/img][/p]
